Hi Evelyn — great questions, and thanks for the clear list. Short answers up front, details/attachments below.

1) Subprocessors: attached is an export of our subprocessor inventory filtered for server-side analytics and telemetry. It includes country of processing and role (ingest, storage, monitoring). See file: subprocessor_inventory_2026-11.csv (attached).

2) DPA and transfers: Redwood executes our standard DPA (attached as dpa_redwood_v2.pdf). For EU-origin telemetry we rely primarily on EU data processing agreements + Standard Contractual Clauses (SCCs) where we transfer to non-adequate jurisdictions. We also offer region pinning for Dedicated/Private deployments to keep processing in the EU for customers that require it.

3) Cookies & telemetry: with server-side tagging, the client-side footprint is minimal. Our client SDK sets a short-lived session cookie by default (necessary for session stitching), but marketing cookies (third-party tracking pixels) are only inserted if you enable the 'marketing_telemetry' toggle in the Console. You can disable marketing telemetry at the org level — I attached server-side-telemetry-config.md with the console toggle paths.

4) Evidence: attaching DPA template and subprocessor inventory. If you need signed copy with your legal's standard redlines, we can circulate a DPA addendum.

Next steps I propose:
- Laura (legal) and Neha (security) from our side to confirm anything in the inventory that needs extra controls.
- If Marketing Labs wants EU-only processing, we can propose Dedicated/region-pinning pricing and a minimal SOW for the pilot.

Regards,

Tessa Morgan

Evelyn / team — quick technical clarifications from security/privacy: 

- The subprocessor inventory includes our CDP partner (CDPCorp) which processes telemetry for enrichment; that vendor has US-based processing for analytics. We have SCCs in place with them.
- For EU-only requirement: region pinning is available but requires Dedicated or Private deployment; toggling at org-level in hosted mode only minimizes telemetry leaving the EU but does not fully guarantee zero US processing because some telemetry pipelines (e.g., enrichment jobs) are routed to partner endpoints.
- Cookie behavior: session cookie is first-party, HTTP-only optional — if Marketing Labs wants no client-side cookies, we can instrument session stitching server-side using first-party fingerprinting and an optional ephemeral token flow; that requires a small SDK change (2-3 day engineering task for pilot).

I attached the filtered inventory (subprocessor_inventory_2026-11.csv) and marked rows where additional contractual controls exist.

-Neha
